messages:
aj: quick proposal — instead of a hard v1 -> v2 forced switch, add a short-lived client opt-in header + server routing that can accept either and prefer v2. wanted to float design and quota/accounting implications.

maria: curious why opt-in vs server-side opt-out? opt-in seems like more client work.

aj: opt-in reduces surprise for customers during deprec. gives tenants control to stay on v1 for a defined grace window. server still prefers v2 unless header present.

samir: big question: how do we bill? if client opts v1 but routed to v2 kernels, do we charge v1 or v2 token rates? needs clear mapping.

kevin: telemetry note — we should tag requests with compat_mode and fallback_reason. metrics: compat_optin_fraction, fallback_rate_by_reason, latency_p95_delta_by_mode, error_rate_delta.

chloe: console UX thought: add a per-tenant "Compat grace" toggle plus a TTL field (e.g., 30d). Also an ability to opt-in via header for single requests. UI should show opt-in fraction and sample traces.

aj: rough header and routing pseudocode:
```
# header examples:
X-Redwood-Compat: v1-grace=30d
X-Redwood-Compat: v1-grace=0d  # opt-out explicitly

# routing (simplified):
if request.headers['X-Redwood-Compat'] indicates v1-grace and not expired:
  route_to = 'v1'
else:
  route_to = 'v2'  # default
# server can override if capacity/health requires fallback
```

maria: accounting: my recommendation — charge by the model variant actually served. If routed to v1 node, map to v1 rates. If v2 node executed (even for v1 API surface), charge v2 rates. we must surface mapping in billing docs.

samir: agreement, + we should prevent opt-in from bypassing stricter rate limits on v2 (abuse vector). add per-tenant guard: opt-in allowed only if tenant health checks pass and no active quota overrides.

kevin: telemetry detail: add request field compat_mode (values: none, v1-grace, forced-v1, server-fallback) and fallback_reason (quota, latency, health, bug). We'll need log schema change + downstream dashboards.

chloe: for console rollout show small cohort toggle: select tenants by tag, and a global % rollout slider. Also add an "auto-revoke" if regression signals exceed threshold.

aj: rollout proposal:
1) feature-flag internals + header acceptance in staging
2) expose compat_mode in logs and quick dashboards (sampling ON)
3) enable per-tenant opt-in toggle behind admin role for 5 pilot tenants
4) run 2-week trial with eval prompt set to detect quality regressions
5) if stable, open opt-in via console to all tenants for 30d grace windows

samir: request: make sure opt-in does NOT change tenant quotas silently. If we route to a variant with different quotas, surface a warning and require owner ack.

aj: agreed — UI should show a confirmation modal listing quota/price impacts.

release-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag "compat_client_optin" created and scheduled for staging rollout 2025-11-12T03:00Z.

infra-bot: infra: added log field compat_mode and fallback_reason to request proto in staging. schema migration queued.

chloe: can we also add a little sample set in console showing example requests under opt-in vs default so customers can preview? small ask but helpful.

maria: also add an eval alert: if error_rate_delta > 0.5% or quality_regression_score > threshold for 48h, auto-undo opt-ins for that tenant and notify on-call.

aj: ok — next actions: (1) samir/maria double-check billing mapping and guard conditions, (2) kevin add telemetry fields to log schema PR, (3) chloe wire mock console screens, (4) I'll open the feature-flag PR and schedule staging.

kevin: thumbs up. I'll draft dashboard panels and a sample query for compatibility slices.

samir: will review billing doc today.

maria: +1. thanks. :thumbsup:

chloe: thanks — exciting to have a less disruptive deprec path :party-parrot:

aj: filing follow-ups and pinging owners. thanks everyone. :rocket:
